sql:
SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Match AS M ON T.team_api_id = M.away_team_api_id
WHERE M.season = '2009/2010' AND M.away_team_goal > M.home_team_goal AND M.league_id IN (
    SELECT L.id
    FROM League AS L
    WHERE L.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
)
GROUP BY T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1
